method: Visible Windows Coding 4.3.0.3 interaction across the complete five-boolean 32-combination product: seeded result load, ambiguous Ctrl+1, ArrowUp/Down edits of existing and new codes, optional comment before/after code, F4 job comment, Ctrl+S, change job and reopen. Synthetic inputs.

cases.probeNotes: Initial digit 0 was also ambiguous (0/10); no code changed. A global-comment draft was cancelled and retried; final confirmation used Enter and advanced one case.

comparison: All decoded result headers, entries, codes, comments, global comment and retained timestamps; changed timestamps are synchronized to the captured native event clock for deterministic browser comparison. Initial case 5, restored-entry progress 4/6 with three actual codes; final reopened case 6 and six codes.
correction: Restore the monotonic native CaseList frontier instead of choosing the first comment-only gap. Display actual code count alongside Windows progress when different.
qualifiedOriginalLimits: E00: confirming the global-comment dialog with Enter bubbles into case navigation in the original. Other cases use Space on OK. The browser uses an inline editor and does not reproduce this incidental extra navigation.
Malformed incomplete earlier result groups retain the previously documented recovery instead of reproducing the original crash.
limits: Finite options and interaction sequence do not prove arbitrary files or histories.
